verdict.rationale: BILL clearly versions its API: it markets a v3 API, uses /v3/ paths, offers a "why upgrade to v3" migration page, and keeps a dated changelog. However, nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods, or support windows for older versions. That leaves only half the story evidenced. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version support lifecycle and notice periods, independent corroboration of version stability.
